Tier-2: 'units cgs' on a deck whose data files are SI is silent.

The two decks differ by ONE leading line. SPARTA's units command changes only
the value of Boltzmann's constant it multiplies your numbers by; it does not
convert the shipped ar.species / ar.vss data, which are SI. Both runs exit 0
and print no warning, the particle count and the compute-temp column are
identical, and only the collision statistics and the Cell-touches diagnostic
betray that the physics has changed.
 POSITIONAL ALIASES added 2026-08-06: this fixture's universal claims are also listed at their slots in the rarefied_flow row. The identity key 'universal:<n>' counts each shared claim once, which is correct; but an external counter walking rarefied_flow's 19 positional slots cannot see it and reports the claim as uncovered. Listing both makes the coverage visible under either convention; the gate collapses the alias onto the identity key so it is still counted once. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 deletes the `units cgs` line from the deck that is supposed to carry it, so both decks are SI and the two runs become identical (max_ncoll 14 vs 14, cell_touches 1.0346 vs 1.0346). Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: cgs_collision_rate_is_far_higher=True, cell_touches_tell_present=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/units_cgs_silently_rescales_si_data && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line. POSITIONAL ALIAS REPOINTED 2026-08-07: eight new rarefied_flow claims were inserted ahead of the shared universal block, moving it from slots 9-18 to 17-26. This fixture's rarefied_flow:<n> entries are the positional spelling of the universal:<n> claims it already names by identity, so only the alias number changed; the evidence, the decks and the mutation control are untouched. The runner key moved with it: pitfall_index 12 -> 20, so this fixture still writes its own row in tier2_results.json.
